newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 73,100 MT were one-fifth less than the previous week, but exceeded the 4-week average by 35 percent.
Major increases for Thailand (20,000 MT), Guatemala (16,000 MT), Algeria (15,000 MT), and Australia (12,000 MT) were partially offset by reductions of 14,000 MT for Ecuador.
Sales of 142,800 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for unknown destinations (50,000 MT), Guatemala (42,500 MT), and Italy (30,000 MT).
Exports of 39,100 MT were off 58 percent from the previous week and 51 percent from the 4-week average. Canada (15,400 MT) and Guatemala (11,000 MT) were the principal recipients.
